conventions.hands: axis 1 of every (T, 2, ...) array: 0 = left, 1 = right
conventions.joints: 21: 0 wrist; thumb 1-4, index 5-8, middle 9-12, ring 13-16, pinky 17-20, base to tip
conventions.world: the episode's own world frame as shipped by EgoVerse; +z appears to point up in these clips (head 0.41-0.55 m above the wrists along +z), undocumented by EgoVerse
conventions.camera: OpenCV: x right, y down, z forward; cam = R^T (world - t) with head_pose_world = [R t; 0 1]
conventions.quaternion: wrist_quat_world is [qw, qx, qy, qz], wrist-to-world rotation from the shipped wrist pose
conventions.in_view: hand labelled, wrist more than 5 cm in front of the camera and its pixel inside the image
conventions.skeleton_px: NaN where the joint is at or behind the camera (z <= 5 cm)

label_source: EgoVerse's shipped labels: estimates from the lab's own hand tracker, not motion capture
